placement_quiz.description: 3 quick questions. 3/3 correct lets the roadmap skip the basics in AI Assistants 101.

questions.question: An AI assistant gives you a statistic for a client report. What should you do?
options: Use it, AI assistants are trained on reliable data
Check it in the original source before using it
Ask the assistant if it is sure, then use it

questions.question: Which prompt will most likely give a usable first draft?
options: Write an email about the delay
Write a short, polite email to a client explaining a 2-day delivery delay and offering a new date

questions.question: The first answer is close but too long. What is usually the best next step?
options: Start a new chat and ask again
Ask a follow-up: shorten it to 5 sentences and keep the key date

placeholders.notes: How practice task_template placeholders are filled. Never insert raw labels or ids.
placeholders.pain: chaos_map.routines[].phrase of the person's top pain (most hours); if none, use the lesson's default_context instead of the template
placeholders.tool: ai_tools[].phrase; if null ("none"), office_suites[].ai_phrase; if that is null too, "an AI assistant"
